verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud publishes a pricing calculator in which you configure a dedicated cluster (with options for High Availability, Search Delivery Network and GPU acceleration) and pay with "no limits on records or operations." That implies predictable cluster/node-based pricing rather than metered search or record charges. The self-hosted GPL engine is also free forever, which gives a zero-license-cost baseline. Missing for 10: actual published per-unit or per-node price figures in the evidence, a documented explanation of how cluster size maps to cost, and independent corroboration that costs are predictable in practice.
